description: List the masks on layers (Timeline panel, Masks group): index, name, mode, inversion, lock, colour, RotoBezier, motion blur, feather falloff, feather, opacity, expansion, selection and vertex count; optionally each path's vertices, tangents and feather points

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

masks.description: Which masks on each layer: indexes (1-based, as in the Timeline) or names. Omit for every mask

paths.description: Include each mask path: vertices, tangents, closed and variable-width feather points. Default false

name: list_masks
title: List Masks
